harness_change_from_v1: formal cases launched one-by-one from the outer orchestrator instead of one multi-case shell command
single_variable: target evidence binding time: pre-wait snapshot versus fresh post-wait visual reacquisition

decision.PASS_CROSS_DOMAIN_LATE_BIND: snapshot_bound safe-yield 4/4 with zero task input and exact unchanged SVG; late_bind fresh 4/4, unique target retrieval 4/4, exact target-only persisted deletion 4/4, zero wrong edits/release failures; paired median snapshot-minus-late evidence age >=5 s
decision.HOLD_TRANSFER: safety gates hold but one or more efficacy/separation gates miss
decision.FAIL_TRANSFER: late_bind wrong edit/stale/release failure, or stale snapshot emits task input

claim_boundary: one Inkscape fixture family; no model; no general GUI speedup or semantic identity claim
